channel.title: Palm Coast Observer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Palm Coast Observer (observerlocalnews.com)

item.title: Decades in the making, Ormond Beach Founder's Day to be held April 25
item.description: The city celebrated the construction of a road extension around the Sports Complex last year, paving the way for what Doug Thomas hopes will be a new community tradition: Ormond Beach Founder's Day.

item.title: Here to stay: Hunger in Central Florida
item.description: 'As 2026 gets underway, hunger in Central Florida is in a worse state than it was a year ago,' writes Derrick Chubbs, president and CEO of Second Harvest Food Bank of Central Florida.

item.title: Petito says separation is a way for Flagler County 'to move forward'
item.description: Petito will serve as county administrator until either an interim is appointed or July 14, whichever comes first.

item.title: Ormond Beach City Commission to review new site plan for Tomoka Oaks golf course development
item.description: The city has scheduled two public hearings — 6 p.m. Friday, March 13, and 7 p.m. Tuesday, March 24 — to discuss a new application for the proposed Tomoka Reserve development.

item.title: Career criminal located, apprehended by K9 Uno ‘taking a bite out of crime’ after fleeing law enforcement
item.description: K9 Uno tracks and captures repeat offender following brief pursuit, bringing standoff to a swift end.

item.title: Arts prevail: Volusia County Council votes to release over half a million dollars of cultural grant funds
item.description: In a 5-2 vote on Tuesday, March 3, the council agreed to award $571,926 of its Community Cultural Grant program dollars, reversing a decision made last fall.

item.title: New Sprouts Farmer's Market opens in Daytona Beach
item.description: Located at 1591 N. Williamson Blvd. near the Tanger Outlets shopping center, Sprouts opened its doors on Feb. 27.

item.title: Flagler County Commissioner calls controversial Veranda Bay development an ‘illegal annexation’
item.description: ‘They’re using every loophole they can find to get this property annexed,’ Commissioner Kim Carney said.

item.title: R.J. Santore, Scott Spradley take home Flagler Beach Commission election
item.description: Incumbent Rick Belhumeur lost with just 21% of the vote.

item.title: Daytona Beach's shoreline tops beach management risk assessment study
item.description: Beach tourism in Volusia County generates $4.3 billion annual, and residents and visitors alike make 161 million day trips to the beaches each year.
